body: claimed: Codex (m3) · 2026-11-15 21:53 UTC · branch mkinney:issue/1976-haas-machines · plan: add five source-backed Haas machines with registry and limit pins

STOPPED. Claim released.

The quick gate failed twice in egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds.

The failed-step gate retry confirmed the same error.
No test was skipped or weakened.

All three new Haas pins failed before the change and pass with the change.
Restoring upstream/main posting.rs makes all three fail again.
Restoring the fix makes all three pass.
The app gate passed all 191 test binaries.
All-targets clippy passed for camcraft-app and camcraft-ui.
The Haas CLI smoke check passed for all five machines without warnings.
No NC or CL goldens changed.

The uncommitted patch remains in /Users/mikekinney/CamcraftPool/.claude/worktrees/issue-1976 on issue/1976-haas-machines.
The branch starts from PR #1753 because it changes MACHINES and the machine-library expectation test.
No branch was pushed and no PR was opened.

The Mini Mill uses the requested 400 ipm cap and assumes installed rigid tapping.
The current Haas Mini Mill page lists faster feed and rapid rates.
The 400 ipm baseline appears in the Haas EDU specifications.
The future PR must explain this configuration and distinguish legacy and Super models.
Flood M8 is the only stated coolant.
The source decision file was not written because work stopped at Step 7.

Build and mutation evidence remains outside the repository in /tmp/1976-*.log and /tmp/1976-cli-smoke.txt.
A permitted cache override resolved the initial sccache directory permission failure.
Resume validation in an environment with a graphics adapter.
